sam: Heads-up — CI is red on PR #8933, failing in tests/integration. Can someone remind me how to rerun just the integration jobs?
leah: click the build link, then there's a 'Retry' dropdown -> 'Retry failed jobs' usually. For CLI: Buildkite-ish: `bk restart --build 98765 --job 'integration-tests'` (replace build id).
maria: if it's GH Actions you can do `gh run rerun 12345678` from the repo, but that reruns whole workflow. There's also `gh api --method POST /repos/:owner/:repo/actions/runs/:run_id/rerun` for finer control.
CI Bot: Build detected: https://ci.internal/redwood/98765 (status: failed) — failed job: integration-tests (node-12).
leah: If you want truly partial: open the pipeline, click the specific job and hit retry on that job — Buildkite exposes per-job retry. If the job depends on artifacts from earlier steps consider rerunning the prior step to regenerate artifacts.
sam: do I need special perms to retry? I remember being blocked earlier.
ashley: You need repo write + membership in the `ci-runners` group for web UI retries. CLI reruns require API token with `repo` + `workflow` scopes.
maria: Another trick for flakiness: run just the test container locally with `docker-compose run --rm integration /bin/bash -c "pytest tests/integration/test_foo.py::test_bar"` to reproduce before wasting CI.
leah: for a rebuild-without-cache (if caching suspected), use the rebuild option: `bk restart --build 98765 --job 'integration-tests' --no-cache` or in GH Actions set `GHA_RUN_NO_CACHE=true` env on a manual dispatch.
sam: ok trying CLI now: `bk restart --build 98765 --job 'integration-tests'`
CI Bot: restart initiated for job integration-tests in build 98765 by sam — new build 98766 queued.
maria: if you only want to retry failed tests inside the job (test-runner supports `pytest --maxfail=1 -k 'flaky_marker'`) you can tweak the job command in the pipeline for a quick per-PR run.
leah: FYI, if you want a safe approach for mainline deploys use the 'Retry failed jobs' button — it respects artifact forwarding and avoids partial artifact mismatch.
sam: new build green on integration! :tada: thanks. Marking flake; will open a flaky test ticket.
ashley: If this becomes frequent, add the flaky test to `tests/flaky_registry.md` with retry=2 so CI auto-retries that test.
deploy-bot: note: automated canary deploy delayed until 6m after PR CI green to avoid racing.
sam: got it, thx all :thumbsup:
